sources.title: Natural millicharged inflation

evidence.text: Use the bulk-matter Coleman–Weinberg potential, whose harmonic weights scale as n^−5, and define the decay-constant matrix as (2πR)^−1 times the inverse charge–coupling matrix. The first harmonic dominates the potential; the numerical inflation potential retains the harmonic sum.

sources.title: Lyth bound of inflation with a tilt

evidence.text: Expand potentials around hilltop or inverse-hilltop benchmarks using coefficients cq. Analyze their effects in large-N and small-μ limits; an n=3 example through fifth order illustrates how endpoint corrections enter at higher powers of μ. Constant-excursion contours are then fitted in the observable plane.
